question.text: The focal chords of the parabola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi></math> which are tangent to the circle of radius <math><mi>r</mi></math> and centre <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mn>6,0</mn></mfenced></math> are perpendicular, then the radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi></math> of the circle is

solution.text:
The focus of the given parabola is 4,0

The centre of the circle with two focal chords as tangent is 6,0

From the figure, 

the distance between the centre of the circle and the focus is 2 units

Hence, the radius of the circle is 2sin45°=2 units
